Direct independent face enumeration of widths 2–7 verifies formulas, not used to extrapolate.

value.rationale: Two independent, all-width rational homological symmetry invariants of a motivated family are determined: one exhibits exact period-three zeros, the other nonperiodic sixth-order transfer data. These distinguish actions that are invisible in nonequivariant Betti bounds and supply constraints without assuming unknown degreewise homology.
